title: Bioanalysis with CSV Input
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol preps 1.5mL and 2mL tubes from stock solutions including but not limited to acetonitrile, water, and methanol. Sources and destinations are determined via a csv uploaded by the user, as well as transfer volumes. Explanation of complex parameters below: * `csv file`: The csv file should be formatted like so. Note - for no mix steps, input "0" for the mix repetition. Also specify whether to mix at the source, or destination tube for that row: * Note: for aspiration height percent (column J), a value of 10 means that we will be aspirating from 10% of the tube depth, 50 will be 50% of the tube depth, etc. * `P20/P1000 Mount`: Specify which mount (left or right) for each single channel pipette. ---
OT-2 visits source labware, source well.

steps.title: Prepare CSV and tube setup
steps.instruction: Set up the required tubes and create the CSV file that drives the robot.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1.5 mL and 2 mL tubes with the appropriate stock solutions (acetonitrile, water, methanol, or any other required solvent).

Create a CSV file formatted with columns for source labware/well, destination labware/well, transfer volume, mix repetitions (use 0 for no mixing), aspiration height percent (column J, e.g., 10 means 10 % of tube depth), and P20/P1000 mount (left or right).

steps.title: Parse CSV file
steps.instruction: Load and parse the CSV file so that each line can be processed sequentially.

steps.title: Attach tip and select pipette
steps.instruction: For each transfer, attach a fresh tip and choose the correct pipette based on volume.

substeps.instruction: Attach a new tip for the upcoming transfer.
If the transfer volume is less than 100 µL, use the P20 single‑channel pipette; otherwise use the P1000 single‑channel pipette.
Mount the selected pipette on the side (left or right) specified in the CSV.

steps.title: Move OT‑2 to source well
steps.instruction: Position the OT‑2 robot over the source labware and well indicated in the current CSV row.

steps.title: Transfer volume to destination
steps.instruction: Aspirate the defined volume from the source and dispense it into the destination well.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the specified volume from the source well at the aspiration height percent given in column J.
Dispense the aspirated volume into the destination well.
If the CSV specifies a mix repetition greater than 0, perform the indicated number of mix cycles at the source or destination tube as indicated.

steps.title: Iterate over all rows
steps.instruction: Repeat the tip‑attachment, movement, and transfer steps for every line in the CSV file.
